production.note: US model years 2015-2025. First: Lexus's 2015 US brochure, '2015 RC F'. Last: Lexus, 16 January 2025: 'the Lexus RC and RC F will officially be discontinued at the conclusion of this model year' (lexus-us-2025-rc-swan-song), which also describes a 2025 Final Edition.

displacementL.note: '5.0-liter'. No opened RC F page prints the cc figure.

transmission.note: 'EIGHT-SPEED SPORT DIRECT-SHIFT SEQUENTIAL TRANSMISSION WITH PADDLE SHIFTERS' (torque-converter automatic). The 2025 release repeats 'eight-speed Sport Direct-Shift transmission'.

powerHp.note: Quote: "472 horsepower (+5) at 7,100 rpm". Rated 467 hp for 2015-2019 (2015 brochure: '467HP HORSEPOWER') and 472 hp from 2020 to 2025 (Lexus 2025 release: 472 hp); 472 hp covers six of eleven model years, so 2020 is the reference year.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL. Standard 2020 RC F (not the Track Edition), 8-speed automatic. CarPro (Amy Plemons): "Weight: 3,902 pounds." Cars.com gives the same for the 2020 RC F RWD: "Base Curb Weight: 3,902 lbs" (cars-com-2020-rc-f). One article and one database. For comparison, Lexus's 2015 brochure gives '3,958LB CURB WEIGHT' for the 467 hp car (lexus-us-rc-brochure-2015), and Lexus gives the 2020 Track Edition 3,781 lb ('the Track Edition weighs 176 pounds less than the previous RC F').

sources.title: The Pinnacle of F: 2020 Lexus RC F and RC F Track Edition
2025 Lexus RC and RC F: A Sonorous Swan Song (16 January 2025)
2020 Lexus RC F performance review (Amy Plemons)

discrepancies.reason: Model year: 3,958 lb is the 2015 car (467 hp); 3,902 lb is the 2020 car after Lexus's weight reductions.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,902 lb, the figure for the reference year (2020).

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 3,902 lb for the 2020 car rests on one article (CarPro) and one database (Cars.com). A Lexus specification sheet for 2020 or later (the pressroom spec PDFs return 403) or a major magazine's spec panel would replace it.
